title: 第15章百官沸腾定国公的威严第16章鱼已入瓮开始闷杀高阳真正的意图
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: 次日，大乾皇宫。
金銮殿上。
斥候飞快的闯入大殿。
“清水城粮价已降至八十二文一斗，崔状元放言，粮价还能再降七文！”
随着斥候的一番话，百官全都一阵诧异，随即议论纷纷，话中毫不掩饰夸赞。
“崔状元之才，真是令人佩服，如此短的时间内，却让清水城粮价跌了足足十八文，甚至还能再降，从贪婪的粮商手上降价，还没有动用恐怖手段，失了朝廷威严，简直无愧状元之才！”
“老夫宋礼，请陛下封赏监察御史崔星河！”
众臣之中，宋礼站了出来，声音响彻金銮殿。
在他心中，这场比试从一开始就注定了结果，剩下的则是看崔星河在清水城的手段。
但崔星河没有辜负他的状元之名，仅仅七日不到的时间，便遏制了清水城上涨的粮价，还令其降低十八文。
这等手段，注定他的通天之路！
待他回京，必定是整个长安都炙手可热的人物。
因此，宋礼不介意卖他一个人情，官场一来二去，感情就深厚了。
更别说，在他心中，崔星河已是宋家的乘龙快婿！
在场一众大臣，哪一个不是人精，自然很快明白了利害关系。
王忠也站出来道，“商贾重利，大灾年间发国难财，简直是常有的事情。”
“但崔状元仅仅只是七日时间，便稳定了清水城粮价，此等手段，简直令人叹服，末将也奏请陛下将崔状元立为典范，令各地官员学习！”
一时间，一个接一个臣子站出来。
“臣附和！”
“臣附和！”
龙椅之上。
武曌身穿金黄色龙袍，周身弥漫着无法直视的高贵。
她心里也有些诧异。
这崔星河还真不是庸才，仅仅七日，不仅稳住了上涨的粮价，还降低了十八文。
此人，倒是可以重用。
这时，王忠好奇道，“清水城距离临江城不过几十里地，清水城粮价低至八十二文，不知临江城粮价该是多少？”
丞相徐玄机沉声道，“清水城的消息到了，想来，临江城的粮价消息也快到了。”
高峰面色凝重。
七日之期已到，若是高阳没能令临江城粮价跌至稳定水平，那今日就危险了。
尤其是这崔星河交出了一份堪称完美的答卷。
这压力更是来到了定国公府的身上。
高阳要是没做好，只怕难以交差。
这背后，早就不单单是一场简单的比试了。
content_en:
The next day, Daqian Palace.
In the Jinluan Palace.
The scouts quickly broke into the hall.
"Report!"
"The price of food in Qingshui City has dropped to eighty-two cents per dou, and Cui Zhuangyuan said that the price of food can drop another seven cents!"
Following the scout's words, all the officials were surprised for a moment, and then started talking about it, with no concealed praise in their words.
"Cui Zhuangyuan's talent is really admirable. In such a short period of time, the price of food in Qingshui City has dropped by a full eighteen cents, and it can even drop further. The greedy grain merchants have lowered the price without resorting to terror and losing the majesty of the imperial court. He is truly worthy of being the number one scholar!"
"I, Song Li, would like to ask your Majesty to reward Cui Xinghe, the supervisory censor!"
Among the ministers, Song Li stood up and his voice echoed throughout the Jinluan Palace.
In his mind, the outcome of this competition was destined from the beginning, and the rest depended on Cui Xinghe's methods in Qingshui City.
But Cui Xinghe lived up to his reputation as the number one scholar. In less than seven days, he curbed the rising food prices in Qingshui City and even reduced them by eighteen cents.
These methods are destined to lead him to heaven!
When he returns to Beijing, he will definitely be a popular figure in Chang'an.
Therefore, Song Li didn't mind selling him a favor, and the relationship became deeper after the officialdom came and went.
Not to mention, in his heart, Cui Xinghe is already the son-in-law of the Song family!
Of all the ministers present, none of them were human beings. Naturally, they quickly understood the stakes.
Wang Zhong also stood up and said, "Businessmen value profits, and it is common for the country to struggle to make money during disaster years."
"But Cui Zhuangyuan stabilized the price of food in Qingshui City in just seven days. These methods are simply amazing. I will also ask Your Majesty to set Cui Zhuangyuan as a model for officials everywhere to learn from!"
For a time, ministers stood up one after another.
"I agree!"
"I agree!"
On the dragon throne.
Wu Zhao was wearing a golden dragon robe, and his whole body was filled with an indescribable nobility.
She was also a little surprised.
This Cui Xinghe is really not mediocre. In just seven days, he not only stabilized the rising food prices, but also reduced them by eighteen cents.
This person can be reused.
At this time, Wang Zhong asked curiously, "Qingshui City is only a few dozen miles away from Linjiang City. The price of food in Qingshui City is as low as eighty-two cents. I wonder what the price of food in Linjiang City is?"
Prime Minister Xu Xuanji said in a deep voice, "The news about Qingshui City has arrived, and I think the news about food prices in Linjiang City is coming soon."
Gao Feng looked solemn.
The seven-day period has come. If Gao Yang fails to bring the price of food in Linjiang City down to a stable level, then today will be in danger.
Especially Cui Xinghe handed in a perfect answer sheet.
This pressure even came to the Duke Dingguo's mansion.
If Gao Yang doesn't do a good job, I'm afraid it will be difficult for him to do business.
Behind this, it is no longer just a simple competition.
